Definitions:																					
Euro area:  As of January 2026, includes Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece, Ireland, Italy,																					
Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Portugal, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Spain.																					
																					
European Union includes Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Croatia, Cyprus, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Estonia, Finland, France, Germany, Greece,																					
Hungary, Ireland, Italy, Latvia, Lithuania, Luxembourg, Malta, the Netherlands, Poland, Portugal, Romania, Slovakia, Slovenia, and Sweden.																					
																					
Purchase and sale note:																					
Sales are sales by the U.S. of securities to a foreign entity.																					
Purchases are purchases by the U.S. of securities from a foreign entity.
